claims.verbatim:
Steamship Pennsylvania (Br.), Lewis, Liverpool, Aug. 15, and
Queenstown 16th, with mdse. and 518 pass. to the National Steam
Nav. Company. 16th inst., off Tuskar, passed ship Screamer bound
up; 17th, lat. 51 24, long. 19 44, steamship Scotia bound E; 19th, lat.
51 09, long. 25, steamship City of Boston bound E; 22d, lat. 48 24, lon.
43, Br. ship Elizabeth Yeo, from Newport, for Montreal; 24th, lat. 45
08, long. 53 13, ship Sebastopol bound E; 25th, 6 a. m., lat. 44 12,
long. 56 30, steamship Java, bound E; same day, 3:14 p. m., lat. 43 47,
long. 57 44, steamship Tripoli, bound E; 27th, lat. 41 29, long. 63 37,
steamship Ericsson bound E.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 30 August 1866, p. 9, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Pennsylvania (Br), Lewis, Liverpool, Aug 15,
via Queenstown 16th, with mdse and 518 passengers, to the
National Steam Navigation Co. 16th inst, off Tuskar, passed
ship Screamer, bound up; 19th, lat 51 09, lon 25, steamship
City of Boston, hence for Liverpool; 22d, lat 48 24, lon 43,
ship Elizabeth Yeo (Br), from Newport for Montreal; 24th,
lat 45 08, lon 53 13, ship Sebastopol, bound E; 25th, 6 AM, lat
44 12, lon 56[?] 30, steamship Java, hence for Liverpool; same
day, 3:14 PM, lat 43 47, lon 57 44, steamship Tripoli, hence
for Liverpool; 27th, lat 41 29, lon 65 37, steamship Ericsson,
hence for Antwerp.
